queries.query: Aydın Turkey official cadastral parcel map service TKGM Parsel Sorgu Aydın municipality GIS
queries.result: Official TKGM Parsel Sorgu documentation was found. It describes the public parcel query service, including province/district/neighborhood/ada-parcel and coordinate-based lookup, map location, area, map-sheet and basic attribute display. An official Aydın Büyükşehir Belediyesi CBS portal was also found, but its fetched landing page was an application shell without an exposed public parcel endpoint in this bounded check.

queries.query: Aydın kadastro parsel sorgu resmi Aydın Büyükşehir Belediyesi kent rehberi parsel
queries.result: The official Turkish TKGM Parsel Sorgu documentation and current viewer were found. The current viewer configuration identified the public MEGSIS API host; the exact-coordinate lookup returned an Aydın/Efeler/Cumhuriyet parcel feature. The official Aydın Büyükşehir Belediyesi CBS shell was reachable but did not reveal a usable parcel service in this bounded inspection.

identityPolicy: Retained sample IDs are source-scoped composites of stable public parcel keys: TKGM province label, district ID, neighborhood ID, adaNo and parselNo. Native source fields and their mapping remain in this metadata, not in GeoJSON properties.
verifiedOpenScope: Two full parcel polygons were verified in a small Aydın city-center neighborhood around the exact WUP point through the anonymous TKGM coordinate endpoint.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: TKGM national public parcel-query service; local Aydın municipal CBS lead separately identified but not integrated.

blocker: A real official public parcel response is qualified locally, but runtime admission is intentionally held pending independent serial adapter review. The endpoint response did not declare a CRS, and the national service is not by itself proof of complete citywide coverage.
remainingUncertainty: The two samples establish local availability and stable public parcel keys near the WUP point only. They do not establish complete Aydın city coverage, a provider-ready adapter contract, or an official CRS declaration in the response.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently re-run the anonymous TKGM coordinate route, confirm identity normalization and CRS handling, and qualify a bounded Aydın adapter before any runtime admission.
